title: THE SMALLEST BODY IS ADMITTED ONLY IF IT FORGETS NOTHING CRITICAL
semantic_thesis: The smallest representation earns admission only by preserving every capability that the frozen reference set requires. Size, average score, and isolated favorable replays cannot purchase the right to replace the reference. In Round-2.1 none of fourteen tested quantized forms preserved all eight frozen FP16-pass capabilities across three replays, while FP16 preserved all 24 required trials; therefore FP16 remains the authoritative runtime representation for this tested gate and the quantized forms remain useful economic approximations only.

ru: Самое маленькое тело допускается не потому, что оно маленькое, а потому, что оно не забывает ни одной критической способности, уже доказанной эталоном.
Один потерянный критический PASS сильнее любого улучшения среднего балла.
Дешёвая аппроксимация может быть полезной, не становясь заменой эталона.
Критический набор замораживается до выбора победителя; победитель не имеет права переписать экзамен.
Один удачный повтор не создаёт устойчивого допуска.
Если ни одно меньшее тело не сохраняет весь критический набор, честный минимальный результат — оставить эталон, а не ослабить правило.
FP16 остаётся эталоном этого допуска не потому, что объявлен совершенным, а потому, что именно он сохранил 24 из 24 замороженных критических проверок в данном эксперименте.
en: The smallest body is admitted not because it is small, but because it forgets none of the critical capabilities already established by the reference.
One lost critical PASS outweighs any improvement in average score.
An economic approximation can remain useful without becoming a replacement for the reference.
The critical set is frozen before a winner is chosen; the winner is not allowed to rewrite the exam.
One favorable replay does not create stable admission.
If no smaller body preserves the whole critical set, the honest minimum is to keep the reference rather than weaken the rule.
FP16 remains authoritative for this gate not because it is declared perfect, but because it preserved all 24 frozen critical trials in this experiment.

architectural_implication.reference_role: Defines frozen capability obligations from prior established PASS evidence; does not claim universal truth.
architectural_implication.candidate_role: May be used as an economic approximation when local policy accepts its known losses, but cannot silently replace the reference under this admission rule.
architectural_implication.promotion_rule: Promotion requires every frozen critical capability to survive every configured replay before size optimization is considered.
architectural_implication.selection_order: First preserve obligations; only then minimize representation size.
architectural_implication.future_extension: Expand the critical set and replicate across runtime/backend/hardware boundaries before making broader deployment claims.

next_semantic_question: Can any compressed representation become admissible after the critical set is expanded and independently replayed across runtimes, or must deployment distinguish an authoritative reference tier from explicitly lossy economic tiers?
boundary: Semantic systems-architecture interpretation of the exact Round-2.1 frozen admission experiment. No universal theorem of quantization, official benchmark-family accuracy, bitwise identity, AGI, consciousness, or general intelligence claim.
